# Inner World Counseling Services, PLLC

> Online (telehealth) therapy practice led by Deirdre Kuvaas, LPCC, offering trauma, PTSD and anxiety therapy, including EMDR and Cognitive Processing Therapy, for adults in North Dakota and Minnesota. Also licensed in Ohio.

## Facts

- **Provider:** Deirdre Kuvaas, LPCC (Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor)
- **Practice:** Inner World Counseling Services, PLLC
- **Format:** Online only (secure video telehealth). No in-person sessions.
- **Licensed in:** North Dakota and Minnesota (LPCC), also Ohio (LPCC)
- **LADC (Licensed Alcohol and Drug Counselor):** Minnesota only
- **NPI:** 1881112399
- **North Dakota LPCC License:** 1330-10-15-23-548
- **Minnesota LPCC License:** 3568
- **Minnesota LADC License:** 305177
- **Ohio LPCC License:** E.2404393
- **Training:** EMDR trained; CPT trained
- **Membership:** EMDRIA (EMDR International Association) member
- **Insurance (in network), as listed on the Rates & Insurance page:**
  - North Dakota: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Dakota, Sanford Health Plan, UnitedHealthcare/Optum/Medica/UMR
  - Minnesota: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota, UnitedHealthcare/Optum/Medica/UMR
  - Ohio: UnitedHealthcare/Optum/Medica
- **Clients:** Adults only (18+)
- **Free consultation:** 15 minutes
- **Book:** [https://deirdrekuvaas.com/appointment-request/](https://deirdrekuvaas.com/appointment-request/)
- **Website:** [https://deirdrekuvaas.com/](https://deirdrekuvaas.com/)

## Specialties

- **Trauma & PTSD:** PTSD; childhood trauma; complex trauma (C-PTSD); relationship or emotional trauma; sexual assault; accidents and sudden events (car accidents, medical emergencies); medical or birth trauma; unresolved trauma from the past
- **Anxiety:** generalized anxiety and constant worry; overthinking and rumination; stress
- **Patterns & self-worth:** people-pleasing; boundaries; perfectionism; inner critic and self-criticism; codependency; feeling stuck in the same patterns; relationship struggles (individual therapy, not couples)
- **Substance use:** substance use counseling (Minnesota only, LADC)
- **Who I work with:** adults (18+); professionals; high achievers; caregivers; healthcare workers; first responders; teachers and educators

## Treatment approaches

- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)
- CPT (Cognitive Processing Therapy)
- IFS-informed
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- Mindfulness-based
- Trauma-informed care

## Professional affiliations

- EMDRIA (EMDR International Association) member
- Verified by Psychology Today
